name: Zendikar
description: Zendikar is a tumultuous plane of wild mana, unstable weather and floating terrain, wracked by the Roil, and the home of Nahiri and Nissa.

bio.text: Nissa came to understand that the Roil was Zendikar's fear of the dark knot, and that she was not chosen by the world but one with it.

timeline.summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
timeline.quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Too drained to planeswalk, Nissa lies helpless as Ulamog's shadow passes over her, devouring the life from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Planeswalking was out of the question.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: A human man pulls Nissa from under the tree and heals her as Ulamog closes in; she blesses him and passes out.
timeline.quote: Stay alive. We'll get you out of here.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Hamadi calls Nissa 'Shaya' as they climb a mountain together.
timeline.quote: I think highly of your will, Shaya,

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa how his people of Graypelt were destroyed by the Eldrazi, and Nissa, overcome by guilt, apologizes.
timeline.quote: She was responsible for all of it, all his loss and all of Zendikar's devastation.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Hamadi, Bahkut, Alira and the kor twins Khali and Sha'heel, who rope the party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders.
timeline.quote: Once everyone was secured, they moved into the gravity fields.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
timeline.quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Nissa frees herself and rides vines down to the ground to fight the Pathrazer, which crushes several travelers.
timeline.quote: Before anyone could act, the Pathrazer had grabbed several of the expedition and crushed them in its tentacled hand.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Khali and Sha'heel snare the Pathrazer with ropes while Nissa pours all her power into earth elementals that crush it.
timeline.quote: the other two hulks bludgeoned the Pathrazer into a wriggling mass of unrecognizable flesh.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa that Zendikar has chosen her and that Shaya means Worldwaker.
timeline.quote: It means 'Worldwaker.'

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis broods over his two defeats, the first taking his body and the second his spark, and the folly of seeking the Veil.
timeline.quote: The first robbed me of my body. The second of my spark.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Deep underground, Ob Nixilis rotates the hedrons on the cavern walls and casts spells, testing their runes.
timeline.quote: He rotated a hedron a few degrees and spoke a brief incantation.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls hating Zendikar and its people, and sees Nahiri's face in each of the kor.
timeline.quote: Because in each of their smug, chalky faces, I see her .

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ob Nixilis was drawn to Zendikar to purge a curse but was attacked and bound with a hedron by Nahiri, which stopped his curse but crippled him.
timeline.quote: I couldn't even scream as she bound the hedron into me.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As the passage crushes in around him, Ob Nixilis drains the stone's vitality and digs toward a green glow.
timeline.quote: He bought himself a moment by bracing himself between the walls, and he muttered a spell.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reveals that the bound hedron took his power and that his wings fell off, leaving him small and weak, and vows revenge.
timeline.quote: The thing she put inside me made me small. Weak.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis studies the hedrons for centuries and lures planeswalkers, letting word of his condition spread until a proud planeswalker comes to extract the hedron.
timeline.quote: And sure enough, some arrogant child finally took my lure.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reaches the glowing source in the depths and takes a flower of green and gold power from a tiny sphere of life, laughing.
timeline.quote: It radiated power, warmth, and health.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows about the hedrons, and that he feels his spark within reach after Bala Ged's destruction.
timeline.quote: My spark is within reach.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Bolas treated him as a mere pawn and dismissed him as a dragon's toy.
timeline.quote: I am dismissed, a dragon's toy, tossed aside and useless.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
timeline.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri decides that Zendikar will be the Eldrazi's prison and she their jailer, and agrees to the plan.
timeline.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer, one world and one Planeswalker standing steadfast to protect all others.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Over forty years, Nahiri pulls hedrons from the earth and Ugin etches them with runes, creating a trap and a lure for the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It took forty years of near-constant work.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's peoples of the coming Eldrazi as the titans slowly approach the hedron-lit plane.
timeline.quote: Nahiri spread word throughout the plane of what was coming

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi stir and Nahiri wakes from her long slumber, a thousand years before the great reawakening.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi stirred. Nahiri woke.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri visits the hedron network's sites, burying the Eldrazi broods she finds, and determines she must stop them alone.
timeline.quote: But she was alone, and she would do it alone.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: A shimmering stream like the one in her vision appears and wraps around Nissa like a cocoon; she connects with Zendikar's soul.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane connected with Zendikar.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Mazik finds Nissa and reveals he followed her with her mother's knowledge; Nissa realizes Zendikar is in pain and wants her help.
timeline.quote: Zendikar isn't after me.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Mazik follow the stream out of the forest and across the canyons, running short of water.
timeline.quote: Together, they followed the stream of glowing light deeper into the forest.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Vampires attack in the bog and Nissa leads Mazik to flight along the stream, but Mazik is separated and trapped in a tree.
timeline.quote: Five vampiric horrors loped after them.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa unexpectedly summons a huge land elemental, controls it, and kills the vampire leader with vines.
timeline.quote: they pierced the vampire straight through his heart.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the Roil is Zendikar's fear of the dark knot and calms the land by humming her mother's animist song.
timeline.quote: It was an animist song, the tune that her mother had hummed to her so many times.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Zendikar forms an elemental from the land to guide Nissa and Mazik to the dark knot.
timeline.quote: a fully formed elemental stepped out of the earth.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa channels Zendikar's power in a massive blast at the mountain but it has no effect.
timeline.quote: it was as though her spell had done nothing.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills an Eldrazi monstrosity on Zendikar with a shard of hedron after a hard fight.
timeline.quote: Hedron connected with boney faceplate.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda and his band find Gideon and tell him that Bala Ged has been overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: Bala Ged, the entire continent, has be overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds a canyon pass against Eldrazi spawn while survivors from Bala Ged escape.
timeline.quote: Gideon planted himself in the narrow path

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: A mage collapses the cliffs with lightning along Munda's iron spikes, burying the Eldrazi spawn.
timeline.quote: sheets of white stone tumbled toward the Eldrazi below.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Munda tells Gideon a great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "A great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Mimicking Ashaya's gesture, Nissa sees glowing leylines stream from her fingers and understands Zendikar did not choose her but she is one with it.
timeline.quote: These were the leylines

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she was never chosen or alone but one with Zendikar and cries 'For Zendikar!', charging into the forest bonded to the land.
timeline.quote: "For Zendikar!" she cried

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya are struck by terrible pain as the connection to Zendikar is torn away, and Ashaya collapses and shatters.
timeline.quote: Nissa watched as Ashaya's branches snapped and shattered on the ground.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes in silence, unable to feel Zendikar or Ashaya, and stumbles toward a sea of Eldrazi at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: But there was nothing there to grasp.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon is welcomed at the encampment with the rescued survivors while Nissa reaches out and finds Zendikar silent and empty.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was empty.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace meets Jori En, who offers her knowledge of the hedron research, and Jace reads her mind instead.
timeline.quote: "I have a better idea, if you're amenable."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Jori's memories of Kendrin's team and her death to the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: She had died to the Eldrazi slaughter before she could pass on enough of what she knew.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace says they must go to the Eye of Ugin; Gideon refuses to leave the encampment and Jace reveals Nissa has left.
timeline.quote: "We already have," said Jace. "Nissa left in the night."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori set out for the Eye without Gideon and discuss whether Jace changed her mind or Gideon's.
timeline.quote: They rode out from the encampment—without Gideon.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi spawn attack Jace and Jori's coach, and the hurda panics.
timeline.quote: When the swarm of Eldrazi spawn crested the hill

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: The kor woman Ayli rescues them, killing the hurda as bait, and leads them into a chasm.
timeline.quote: sliced through the hurda's neck with one of the sharp hooks.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Ayli presents Jace and Jori as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship.
timeline.quote: "Welcome, offerings, to the sanctuary," said Ayli

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Ulamog is drawn to concentrations of population and that Sea Gate and other refuges will become tombs.
timeline.quote: And those trusted landmarks would become—tombs.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace uses an illusion to make the Pilgrims believe they are on fire, and he and Jori escape.
timeline.quote: "Stop," said Jace, and the man burst into flames.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Jori someone must warn Gideon that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate while he goes on to the Eye alone.
timeline.quote: "Go back and warn them. I'm going to the Eye."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace alters Jori's mind to make her think she chose to return, and she walks on toward Sea Gate, cursing him.
timeline.quote: "God damn it, Jace."

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa keeps vigil each twilight at the bluff where Zendikar was torn from her, finding only emptiness.
timeline.quote: She kept vigil there, returning each day to ground herself

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Pili's insistence that she knew inspires Nissa to realize Zendikar's soul may have retreated to Khalni Heart.
timeline.quote: If something had happened, if the titan had threatened the world's soul, that's where it would have run to.

citation.text: "Nissa's Quest" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As children, Kiora and Turi listen to Elder Misha's Cosi story about Cosi swapping Ula's spear for a feather.
timeline.quote: Cosi snuck to Ula's bedside at the bottom of the sea and swapped his great spear for a gull's feather

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora finds an altar to the Three in a cave and spits in Ula's face before sleeping beneath Cosi's statue.
timeline.quote: And she spit in Ula's blank, stupid face.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora uses the bident and sea creatures to drive Eldrazi off a hundred merfolk refugees.
timeline.quote: A vortex formed near one of the Eldrazi, sending it tumbling.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora reunites with her sister Turi, who tells her Kozilek and Emrakul have not been seen for months and that Ulamog is at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "No one's seen him in months," she said.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora announces she will go to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog, and Yenai says his group will flee to Murasa.
timeline.quote: "Depends," said Kiora. "I'm going to Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tells a Cosi story about a mortal who steals Ula's spear, calling a wave that parts around the merfolk.
timeline.quote: A great wave broke over and around her

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora promises Turi she will return, and half a dozen of Cosi's devotees follow her on a serpent toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: And half a dozen of the merfolk quietly came and stood beside her.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she is neither her old self nor her controlled self and pours her essence into Khalni Heart, letting it root in the land.
timeline.quote: Nissa collected all the power left within her

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The land swallows Khalni Heart and Zendikar's soul returns to the land, defeating the demon's plan.
timeline.quote: The world's soul had returned to the land.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks to Zendikar for just one peek and lands near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: She pressed her will against the whereness around her, forcing it to change.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A scout on a manta nearly spots Chandra, who runs into three Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: she was face-to-faceplate with a trio of angular, meaty-ribbed, bony-headed creatures.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra kills the three Eldrazi with fire.
timeline.quote: creating a tripartite blade of fire that sliced through each one of them.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
timeline.quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin imprison the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar using a network of hedrons built by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: The Planeswalkers' trap worked.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A little over a thousand years ago the Eldrazi nearly escape and Nahiri restores their prison alone, then goes to check on her absent allies and is not seen again.
timeline.quote: Nahiri restored the Eldrazi's prison on her own

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Zendikar, defends the Zendikari, faces a titan and leaves to seek reinforcements on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Vowing to return, he left in search of aid at the center of Planeswalker activity: the city-world of Ravnica.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora summons Lorthos, who appears as a vast darkness, and she pleads with him to fight the interlopers.
timeline.quote: She summoned, and he came!

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Kozilek repeatedly resurrects and kills Gideon for amusement.
timeline.quote: Another twitch, another ripple , and Gideon Jura was reborn again

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: after Kozilek leaves, Tazri spends ten thousand years trying to recreate Zendikar, and then billions of years in sleep waiting for him.
timeline.quote: For the first ten thousand years after Kozilek's disappearance, Tazri had used her new powers to attempt the reconstruction.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri tells herself the story of the day Gideon died through the dead cosmos.
timeline.quote: This is the story of the day Gideon died.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The halo shields Tazri's mind, and she meets the angel she killed in a white void outside time.
timeline.quote: We are outside of time, Tazri.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri refuses to be healed, saying the sacrifice was hers, and the angel tells her she is forgiven and that Zendikar can win.
timeline.quote: You can win. You will win. There is no other option.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
timeline.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon's dented buckler in the mud and recalls her parents' deaths on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: It was a large buckler shield, wedged in a depression of mud.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri and wounded scouts hail Chandra from a ravine and tell her the demon took Gideon and two others to a cavern.
timeline.quote: The demon took him, and two others.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures the Eldrazi swarm away from Tazri's wounded in a cyclone of fire.
timeline.quote: A roaring cyclone made of churning flame whirled across the field ahead of her

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
timeline.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace stops Gideon from making empty promises to a distraught Nissa.
timeline.quote: Don't make promises you can't keep,

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace suggests leaving Zendikar to its fate, and Nissa refuses and the ground trembles.
timeline.quote: I'm not going anywhere,

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But maybe four of us can,

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa swears the oath to keep watch.
timeline.quote: for the life of every plane, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace swears the oath, warning that Emrakul could be drifting through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra swears the oath, saying every world has its tyrants, and Nissa embraces her.
timeline.quote: If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
timeline.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon is reunited with the group, and Kiora offers a humble request for the next move.
timeline.quote: Which is why I'm here, now, asking you what we are going to do.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace presents half a plan with the glyph that Ugin showed him, since a hedron trap for two titans is impossible.
timeline.quote: It's no longer possible to trap Kozilek and Ulamog,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace announces that since they cannot trap the titans nor let them leave, they will kill them, revealing Ugin's warning he had promised to heed.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace proposes using the army as bait to bring the titans together, and Tazri says bait does not get a choice.
timeline.quote: The titans are drawn to concentrations of life,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
timeline.quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa shares her mind and memories with Jace, showing how the hedron network contained the titans and how the Roil was the world fighting back.
timeline.quote: She'd thought her world was angry. She hadn't realized it was fighting for its life.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Jace conceive a plan to drain the titans' energy into Zendikar's leylines without hedrons, so the plane can devour them.
timeline.quote: So this world can do to them what they 've been trying to do to it.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she removed the last failsafe and let the Eldrazi out, and Jace confesses he was part of the reason the failsafe was needed.
timeline.quote: I let them out, said Nissa.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
timeline.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
timeline.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Jace he trusts him despite the demon's warning about telepaths.
timeline.quote: I trust you,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace rallies the rear guard troops with Nissa, telling them they are the most important people on the battlefield.
timeline.quote: She'll be binding the titans, and ultimately she'll be the one who kills them.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Sorin helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and that Jace and two other planeswalkers inadvertently freed them (recounted).
timeline.quote: Manipulated and coerced, two other Planeswalkers and I inadvertently released the Eldrazi titans from their prison.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Recounted: Nahiri stood watch over the imprisoned Eldrazi for five thousand years, then fought them off alone when they escaped.
timeline.quote: For five thousand years, Nahiri stood watch over their monstrous prisoners.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks home to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Her feet found the rocky earth of Zendikar, and for the first time since her imprisonment began, she stood on solid ground.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives to Chandra's greeting and the smiling face of his friend.
timeline.quote: the afterimage of Emrakul looming above gave way to the smiling face of his friend.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels overwhelmed and alone among the crowds of Ravnica, cut off from Zendikar's voice.
timeline.quote: She'd never been among so many, and never been so alone.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Akiri leaves her kor band after an Eldrazi attack kills her comrades.
timeline.quote: she struck out on her own when an Eldrazi attack killed her comrades

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin flees through Zendikar, Kephalai and Ravnica with Bolas in pursuit, wounded by his venomous magic.
timeline.quote: From bustling Kephalai to growing Ravnica and on and on, he flees with Nicol breathing down his neck

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Norn has Nissa show Zendikar's forests and a Skyclave, and Nahiri vows to wake the weapon.
timeline.quote: I can wake it once more to enact our will.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri departs for Zendikar.
timeline.quote: In three steps, she winks out of existence

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri smothers the Roil's attacks, reducing the landscape to bedrock.
timeline.quote: Eventually the earth quiets.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Skyclave falls with the corrupted Planeswalker trapped inside, while the sky takes on a soft iridescent glow.
timeline.quote: The Emeria Skyclave is falling to the earth.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees the extent of Phyrexia's wreckage of Zendikar and concedes it is her fault.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: This was her fault.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri resolves to restore her spark and seek help from Kesenya.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Which meant, first things first, finding a way to restore her spark.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri blames Planeswalkers for Zendikar's ruin and vows that none will set foot on Zendikar again.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: No Planeswalker will set foot on Zendikar ever again.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: They emerge on Zendikar and decide to follow the portals; Garruk senses Eldrazi illusions.
timeline.quote: "Eldrazi are near. More illusions of them, anyway."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Through the next portal the group falls to a rooftop memory in the rain, with Alhammarret's body dying.
timeline.quote: At the center of it all is a gargantuan sphinx.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Garruk kneels by the young Jace, who does not know who he is, and promises to protect him; the boy vanishes into Garruk's mind as the Clean Slate.
timeline.quote: "I will protect the child."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The sphinx rises again, and the nightmare compels Garruk to jump off the ledge.
timeline.quote: Garruk draws his axe and lurches forward to swing but suddenly knows he needs to turn around

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra reach the portal, but Vraska, compelled by the sphinx, steps off the edge of the building.
timeline.quote: And as easily as one would step off the last stair, she steps over the edge.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.quote: Nahiri has frequently set aside traveling the Multiverse for the greater good of her homeland.

citation.text: "Nahiri". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The ancient planeswalkers use the hedrons to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi, who remain trapped for millennia.

citation.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
